verdict.rationale: Metorial documents a public REST API. Secret and publishable API keys come from the dashboard (metorial-docs-24), and an OpenAPI spec is served at /openapi.json (metorial-probe-3). A keyless probe of api.metorial.com/providers returned a machine-readable 401 naming the Bearer-token contract, which shows the API is live and key-gated as documented (metorial-probe-rt-3). The API is also exposed through official TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs and REST session payloads with tool filters and connection URLs (metorial-docs-1, metorial-docs-15, metorial-docs-16), plus an llms.txt that indexes the API reference (metorial-probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: evidence of how far the API's endpoint coverage extends across product features, and independent community reports of driving the product through the REST API.
